
Like most structures in [[Lojban|Lojban]], [[tanru|tanru]] are left-branching. Take "lenku cakla ladru" as an example. It parses as "[[lenku cakla) ladru)", ie. "cold-chocolate milk", not "cold chocolate milk". If you want the latter, you must say "lenku [ke|ke]] cakla ladru" or "lenku cakla [[bo|bo]] ladru".

What's Gotcha-ish about that?

Gotchas to my (mi'e [[User:Nick Nicholas|nitcion]]) mind include not only potential errors of understanding, but also potential errors of production. Naively, one would say ''lenku cakla ladru'' for "cold chocolate milk". Hence the '''bzzt!'''
